# Siemens acquires Altair

Altair has been acquired by Siemens, creating the world's most complete AI-powered portfolio of
industrial software for simulation, high-performance computing, data science and artificial
intelligence as part of the Siemens Xcelerator platform.

## Forward together with Siemens

[digital industries altair brandmark with a white background ]

For forty years, Altair has explored the science of possibility with our customers. We have made the
impossible, possible by leveraging the convergence of rocket science and data science, propelled by
high-performance computing.

As Altair technology joins Siemens, the world’s #1 industrial software company, we’re poised to help
you create faster, build smarter and scale beyond what we ever imagined, together.

## Helping you find your way

Transform and scale your processes with cutting edge solutions within the Siemens Xcelerator
portfolio. Altair software has been integrated throughout the Siemens software portfolio to continue
providing proven results for your toughest challenges.

[Two people are collaborating in an office, looking at a large screen displaying a 3D engineering
design of a complex part]

### Altair HyperWorks

The software within the Altair HyperWorks platform have been integrated into the Simcenter
simulation and test solution portfolio.

[Learn about Simcenter][7]
[altair-hpcworks-server-room]

### Altair HPCWorks

HPC and cloud products that were formerly within the Altair HPCWorks platform can now be found
within HPCWorks.

[Learn about HPCWorks][8]
[A person is seen from behind, working on a laptop displaying an "Auto AI" data science interface
with a decision tree diagram]

### Altair RapidMiner

Data analytics, AI, and machine learning solutions that were part of the Altair RapidMiner portfolio
are now part of Rapidminer.

[Learn about Rapidminer][9]

### Altair One

Access your tools, data, and computing resources while unleashing the power of AI with Altair One, a
revolutionary cloud gateway.

[More about Altair One][10]

### Altair Units

Get full access to our suite of software tools whenever you need them with Altair Units. Learn more
about our all-in and always-on licensing system.

[More about Altair Units][11]

### Altair Partner Alliance

The Altair Partner Alliance is now referred to as the Advanced Partner Alliance. Learn how to become
a partner and how you can benefit as a customer.

[More about APA][12]

## Customer support

****

### Visit the Siemens Customer Center

Altair's support services have transitioned to the Siemens Support Center. For up-to-date
information on the migration and for getting started how-to’s on the Siemens Support Center please
visit the following pages:
* [Support migration updates][13]
* [Siemens Digital Industries Software - Getting started][14]
* [Four steps to: Register for Support Center][15]
* [Starting your Support Center Journey][16]

[Visit Customer Center][17]
[A young woman wearing a striped shirt and a lavender top, is focused on a computer monitor at her
desk, holding a pen]

## Additional resources

* [Contact us][18]
* [Learning and training ][19]
* [Free trials ][20]

6. Siemens acquires Altair

# Siemens acquires Altair

Altair has been acquired by Siemens, creating the world's most complete AI-powered portfolio of
industrial software for simulation, high-performance computing, data science and artificial
intelligence as part of the Siemens Xcelerator platform.

## Forward together with Siemens

[digital industries altair brandmark with a white background ]

For forty years, Altair has explored the science of possibility with our customers. We have made the
impossible, possible by leveraging the convergence of rocket science and data science, propelled by
high-performance computing.

As Altair technology joins Siemens, the world’s #1 industrial software company, we’re poised to help
you create faster, build smarter and scale beyond what we ever imagined, together.

## Helping you find your way

Transform and scale your processes with cutting edge solutions within the Siemens Xcelerator
portfolio. Altair software has been integrated throughout the Siemens software portfolio to continue
providing proven results for your toughest challenges.

[Two people are collaborating in an office, looking at a large screen displaying a 3D engineering
design of a complex part]

### Altair HyperWorks

The software within the Altair HyperWorks platform have been integrated into the Simcenter
simulation and test solution portfolio.

[Learn about Simcenter][7]
[altair-hpcworks-server-room]

### Altair HPCWorks

HPC and cloud products that were formerly within the Altair HPCWorks platform can now be found
within HPCWorks.

[Learn about HPCWorks][8]
[A person is seen from behind, working on a laptop displaying an "Auto AI" data science interface
with a decision tree diagram]

### Altair RapidMiner

Data analytics, AI, and machine learning solutions that were part of the Altair RapidMiner portfolio
are now part of Rapidminer.

[Learn about Rapidminer][9]

### Altair One

Access your tools, data, and computing resources while unleashing the power of AI with Altair One, a
revolutionary cloud gateway.

[More about Altair One][10]

### Altair Units

Get full access to our suite of software tools whenever you need them with Altair Units. Learn more
about our all-in and always-on licensing system.

[More about Altair Units][11]

### Altair Partner Alliance

The Altair Partner Alliance is now referred to as the Advanced Partner Alliance. Learn how to become
a partner and how you can benefit as a customer.

[More about APA][12]

## Customer support

****

### Visit the Siemens Customer Center

Altair's support services have transitioned to the Siemens Support Center. For up-to-date
information on the migration and for getting started how-to’s on the Siemens Support Center please
visit the following pages:
* [Support migration updates][13]
* [Siemens Digital Industries Software - Getting started][14]
* [Four steps to: Register for Support Center][15]
* [Starting your Support Center Journey][16]

[Visit Customer Center][17]
[A young woman wearing a striped shirt and a lavender top, is focused on a computer monitor at her
desk, holding a pen]

#### About the COMSOL Product Suite

The COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} software brings a user interface and experience that is always the same,
regardless of engineering application and physics phenomena.

Add-on modules provide specialized functionality for electromagnetics, structural mechanics,
acoustics, fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical engineering. Choose from a list of LiveLink™
products to interface directly with CAD and other third-party software. Deploy simulation
applications with COMSOL Compiler™ and COMSOL Server™.

[Explore Product Suite ][38]
COMSOL Multiphysics^{®}

Create physics-based models and simulation applications with this software platform. The Model
Builder enables you to combine multiple physics in any order for simulations of real-world
phenomena. The Application Builder gives you the tools to build your own simulation apps. The Model
Manager is a modeling and simulation management tool.

[View COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} ][39]

SIMULATION APP DEPLOYMENT
COMSOL Compiler™

Compile apps into standalone executable files that can be run by anyone, anywhere.

[View COMSOL Compiler™ ][40]
SIMULATION APP DEPLOYMENT
COMSOL Server™

Manage and distribute your organization's apps and run them via web browser or thin client.

[View COMSOL Server™ ][41]

Get to Know COMSOL

At COMSOL, we develop mathematical modeling software that drives new breakthroughs in physics and
engineering — and we love what we do.

Our mission is to provide easy-to-use software solutions to engineering problems and to help our
users get the most out of our products. We envision sustaining and reinforcing our position as a
leading provider and developer of mathematical modeling software. We also aim to make our technology
the primary tool for engineers, researchers, and lecturers within the fields of education and
high-tech product development.

**Quick Facts**
* Founded in 1986
* 16 offices and a distributor network throughout the world
* 500+ employees globally

#### **Featured Case Studies**

[[Chemical Surface Detector (CSD) - Access Engineering]][116]

#### [**Chemical Surface Detector (CSD)**][117]

Access Engineering provided mechanical design and FEA analysis of CSD system that leverages UV Raman
spectroscopy to provide high-speed, on-the-move detection and identification of chemicals on
surfaces for the military.

[[High Energy Laser (HEL) Beam Director]][118]

#### [**High Energy Laser (HEL) Beam Director**][119]

Mechanical design and analysis of a gimbal which is a critical component used in directed energy
systems. Its provides precise aiming and stabilization of the energy beam to the target.

[[Joint Biological Standoff Detection System (JBSDS)]][120]

#### [**Joint Biological Standoff Detection System (JBSDS)**][121]

Mechanical Engineering support for a LIDAR system that enables standoff detection, discrimination,
and warning of Biological Warfare Agent (BWA) clouds.

[[Compact Thermal Management System]][122]

#### [**Compact Thermal Management System**][123]

Mechanical design and development of a passive heat pipe system to cool down a UV Raman laser
chamber. CAD and FEA tools are implemented iteratively to satisfy client’s MIL-STD-810G reliability
requirements.

[[Process Skid for a Concentrated Solar System]][124]

#### [**Process Skid for a Concentrated Solar System**][125]

Access Engineering designed and developed a compact heat exchanger pumping station unit to cool down
and extract the thermal energy from a utility-scale concentrated photovoltaic thermal (CPVT)
receiver.

[[Pulsed Power Marx System with Spiral Horns]][126]

#### [**Pulsed Power Marx System with Spiral Horns**][127]

Mechanical design of a Marx-type Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP) generator. It generates bursts of EM
energy that disrupts or destroys electronic systems in a targeted area without direct harm to people
or infrastructure.

#### **Featured Case Studies**

[[Chemical Surface Detector (CSD) - Access Engineering]][116]

#### [**Chemical Surface Detector (CSD)**][117]

Access Engineering provided mechanical design and FEA analysis of CSD system that leverages UV Raman
spectroscopy to provide high-speed, on-the-move detection and identification of chemicals on
surfaces for the military.

[[High Energy Laser (HEL) Beam Director]][118]

#### [**High Energy Laser (HEL) Beam Director**][119]

Mechanical design and analysis of a gimbal which is a critical component used in directed energy
systems. Its provides precise aiming and stabilization of the energy beam to the target.

[[Joint Biological Standoff Detection System (JBSDS)]][120]

#### [**Joint Biological Standoff Detection System (JBSDS)**][121]

Mechanical Engineering support for a LIDAR system that enables standoff detection, discrimination,
and warning of Biological Warfare Agent (BWA) clouds.

[[Compact Thermal Management System]][122]

#### [**Compact Thermal Management System**][123]

Mechanical design and development of a passive heat pipe system to cool down a UV Raman laser
chamber. CAD and FEA tools are implemented iteratively to satisfy client’s MIL-STD-810G reliability
requirements.

[[Process Skid for a Concentrated Solar System]][124]

#### [**Process Skid for a Concentrated Solar System**][125]

Access Engineering designed and developed a compact heat exchanger pumping station unit to cool down
and extract the thermal energy from a utility-scale concentrated photovoltaic thermal (CPVT)
receiver.

[[Pulsed Power Marx System with Spiral Horns]][126]

#### [**Pulsed Power Marx System with Spiral Horns**][127]

Mechanical design of a Marx-type Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP) generator. It generates bursts of EM
energy that disrupts or destroys electronic systems in a targeted area without direct harm to people
or infrastructure.

Access provides the best value solutions to your mechanical
engineering and prototyping needs. We take your ideas and
make them a reality.

## Creating a Sustainable Future

At Advanced Composites, sustainability isn’t just a goal—it’s built into everything we do. From
eco-conscious material formulations to waste-reducing production processes, we are committed to
helping the automotive industry meet its environmental targets. Together, we’re driving innovation
that supports a cleaner, more efficient tomorrow.

[ Learn More ][83]

## Colors for the Road Ahead

Our color technologies bring precision, consistency, and creativity to every formulation. Whether
matching OEM standards or developing custom shades, Advanced Composites offers vibrant, durable, and
scalable color solutions that enhance both design and performance—paving the way for standout
vehicles on the road ahead.

[ Learn More ][84]

## Where Your Potential Meets Opportunity

Join a team of innovators and make an impact in the automotive industry. Explore exciting career
opportunities, professional growth, and a collaborative environment to unlock your full potential.

[ Get Started ][85]

## Driving Innovation, Shaping the Future

Innovation is at the heart of every solution we deliver. At Advanced Composites, we combine advanced
material science with industry insight to develop cutting-edge compounds that power the vehicles of
tomorrow. By anticipating the needs of our customers, we’re helping shape the future of mobility—one
breakthrough at a time.

[ Learn More ][86]

## 2024 SPE Automotive Innovation Awards Recipient

Rivian R1T & R1S Exterior Cladding with Living Hinge

[ Learn More ][87]

## Welcome to Advanced Composites

We think creatively and dynamically to lead market change by improving our products, technology and
systems.

Advanced Composites is the leading supplier of TPO’s (Thermoplastic Olefins) and Polypropylene
Compounds to the North American Automotive Industry.  Our line of products consists of proprietary
formulations designed to meet specific OEM applications. Our customers include all of the domestic
and transplant OEM’s, as well as their major T1 and T2 suppliers.

In order to provide industry-leading technologies, Advanced Composites contributes extensive
resources to research and product development.  Our unwavering goal is to make available to our
customers products and technical support that together will reduce their overall costs and improve
the quality of their products.

materials, but also the technical expertise, logistics support, and dependable service needed to
keep projects moving forward.

At the core of our operations is a commitment to advanced material science. Our engineers develop
proprietary formulations that are precisely tailored to meet the mechanical, thermal, and aesthetic
requirements of specific OEM applications. From concept to production, we work closely with
customers to deliver high-performance TPO and polypropylene compounds.

dispersion of additives, colorants, and reinforcements. This consistency in production leads to
superior product quality and reliability across large-volume automotive applications.

Every batch of material we produce undergoes rigorous physical property testing to verify compliance
with OEM specifications. Our in-house labs evaluate key attributes like tensile strength, impact
resistance, and melt flow, ensuring that customers receive materials they can trust.

certification, our team follows strict quality control protocols designed to exceed industry
standards. Real-time monitoring and data-driven improvements keep our operations efficient and
precise.

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

brands with dedicated service modules.

Draftings Australia is a specialist drafting company operating across Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne,
Perth, and the Gold Coast. Unlike generalist design firms, we focus exclusively on CAD drafting and
technical documentation — which means faster turnaround, sharper accuracy, and a team that speaks
the same language as your engineers and builders.

As a dedicated drafting company, we work directly with project managers, engineers, architects,
fabricators, and contractors. We do not subcontract. Every drawing is produced by our in-house team
under quality control reviewed against Australian Standards.
* →**Specialised:** CAD drafting only — not a side service of a larger design practice
* →**National:** Teams in Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Perth and Gold Coast
* →**Fast:** 24-hour quote turnaround; most projects started within 48 hours
* →**Flexible:** Project-based, hourly, or ongoing contract arrangements
* →**Compliant:** All drawings to AS1100, AS4100, AS3600, AS1554 as standard

EL FORGE is one of the leading forging producers in South India with over of 6 decades of experience
in metal forming. EL FORGE serves major vehicle and automotive component manufacturers and process
industries, both domestic and overseas. The range of materials handled include Micro alloy steels,
Carbon, Alloy and Stainless Steel, and supplies are made both as forged and machined.

1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

## CAD & Design Solutions for Any Use Case

No matter the type of work you want to do, IMSI has a solution that will fit your needs. Find yours
today!

[Architectural Design]

#### Architectural Design

Create extensive and accurate plans with precision tools offered by TurboCAD’s solutions and apps.
View, simulate, and customize your 2D and 3D design ideas; visualize results with photorealistic
rendering. [» Learn more][169]

[Interior Design]

#### Interior Design

Visualize your Interior Design ideas, choose and personalize lightweight blinds, curtain fabrics,
material, sofa styles, or furniture. Evaluate your ideas in minimal time with easy to use
drag-and-drop tools. [» Learn More][170]

[Sheet Metal Design]

#### Sheet Metal Design

Use powerful TurboCAD 3D modification tools well suited to sheet metal design for bend, unbend, tube
bend and tube flange creation; imprint, unfold and tweak faces, and hole creation. [» Learn
more][171]

[Mechanical Design]

#### Mechanical Design

It is vital for businesses in the mechanical industry to conceptualization new tools. Use our
built-in Redsdk engine for enhanced drawing performance in wireframe, hidden-line and conceptual
rendered viewing. [» Learn More][172]

[3D Printing]

#### 3D Printing

Turn your 3D models into solid finished products with the latest additive manufacturing technology.
Rapid prototyping has never been easier with TurboCAD as you can simply convert and export 3D files
into a watertight STL format. [» Learn more][173]

[Woodworking & Furniture Design]

#### Woodworking & Furniture Design

Furniture making has evolved with time. With that understanding, our product's design engine helps
leverage users in carving out complex woodwork in the quickest amount of time. [» Learn more][174]

#### Interior Design

Visualize your Interior Design ideas, choose and personalize lightweight blinds, curtain fabrics,
material, sofa styles, or furniture. Evaluate your ideas in minimal time with easy to use
drag-and-drop tools. [» Learn More][170]

#### Sheet Metal Design

Use powerful TurboCAD 3D modification tools well suited to sheet metal design for bend, unbend, tube
bend and tube flange creation; imprint, unfold and tweak faces, and hole creation. [» Learn
more][171]

[Mechanical Design]

#### Mechanical Design

It is vital for businesses in the mechanical industry to conceptualization new tools. Use our
built-in Redsdk engine for enhanced drawing performance in wireframe, hidden-line and conceptual
rendered viewing. [» Learn More][172]

#### 3D Printing

Turn your 3D models into solid finished products with the latest additive manufacturing technology.
Rapid prototyping has never been easier with TurboCAD as you can simply convert and export 3D files
into a watertight STL format. [» Learn more][173]

## Data verbindt

trotse partners van
[Microsoft][15] en [Cadence][16]
[ Ontdek meer ][17]

# Optimize the world using data

De snel veranderende wereld van vandaag stelt organisaties voortdurend voor nieuwe uitdagingen.
Energietransitie, stijgende grondstofprijzen en een tekort aan gekwalificeerde mensen dwingen je
steeds kritischer om te gaan met resources. Hier komt In Summa om de hoek kijken.

[ Vraag advies aan ][18]
[ Over in summa ][19]

[Computer-Aided Engineering][20]

[Data Solutions ][21]

[Over in Summa][22]

## Data toegankelijk in praktische business intelligence dashboards

Bij In Summa is juist dit wat wij zichtbaar willen maken voor onze klanten in de maakindustrie,
transportsector en zorg. Als Microsoft Solution partner maken wij data toegankelijk en beschikbaar
in praktische business intelligence dashboards. Dankzij onze intensieve kennis van de branches en de
processen kunnen onze data engineers bedrijfsprocessen effectief optimaliseren door databronnen slim
met software te verbinden.

[ Ontdek meer over Business Intelligence ][23]

## Realisatie door betrokken en gedreven engineers

Daarnaast is In Summa exclusieve business partner van Hexagon’s Computer-Aided Engineering platform
voor de Benelux regio. Met deze state-of-the-art simulatiesoftware kunnen engineers en researchers
uit verschillende industriële sectoren ontwerpen virtueel en proactief testen op veiligheid,
kosten en duurzaamheid. Zo optimaliseren we samen resources voor diverse industriële sectoren. 

Omdat onze toegewijde en gedreven engineers de [Hexagon][24] tools van binnen en van buiten kennen,
kunnen wij onze klanten bovendien optimaal ondersteunen met advies en training.

[ Ontdek meer over Simulatie Software ][25]

## En dat sinds 1998, met een enorme passie voor data en techniek

Dat doen wij al sinds 1998 met een enorme passie voor data en techniek en een echte
resultaatgerichte, no-nonsense mentaliteit. In een open, transparante werkomgeving geven wij onze
specialisten graag de ruimte om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. De liefde voor het vak, de vrijheid
en de synergie tussen onze young potentials en vakrotten resulteren in een hecht teamgevoel.

## Werken in een data gedreven organisatie?

Bij In Summa werken wij voor klanten in de [maakindustrie][26], [transportsector][27] en [zorg][28].
En als [Microsoft Solution partner][29] maken wij data toegankelijk en beschikbaar in praktische
business intelligence dashboards. Dit doen wij in een hecht team dat op elkaar bouwt. Elke dag weer
werken we aan de mooiste resultaten. Ben jij enthousiast geworden en wil je bij ons werken?
Solliciteer dan vandaag nog!

# Optimize the world using data

De snel veranderende wereld van vandaag stelt organisaties voortdurend voor nieuwe uitdagingen.
Energietransitie, stijgende grondstofprijzen en een tekort aan gekwalificeerde mensen dwingen je
steeds kritischer om te gaan met resources. Hier komt In Summa om de hoek kijken.

[ Vraag advies aan ][18]
[ Over in summa ][19]

[Computer-Aided Engineering][20]

[Data Solutions ][21]

[Over in Summa][22]

## Data toegankelijk in praktische business intelligence dashboards

Bij In Summa is juist dit wat wij zichtbaar willen maken voor onze klanten in de maakindustrie,
transportsector en zorg. Als Microsoft Solution partner maken wij data toegankelijk en beschikbaar
in praktische business intelligence dashboards. Dankzij onze intensieve kennis van de branches en de
processen kunnen onze data engineers bedrijfsprocessen effectief optimaliseren door databronnen slim
met software te verbinden.

[ Ontdek meer over Business Intelligence ][23]

## Realisatie door betrokken en gedreven engineers

Daarnaast is In Summa exclusieve business partner van Hexagon’s Computer-Aided Engineering platform
voor de Benelux regio. Met deze state-of-the-art simulatiesoftware kunnen engineers en researchers
uit verschillende industriële sectoren ontwerpen virtueel en proactief testen op veiligheid,
kosten en duurzaamheid. Zo optimaliseren we samen resources voor diverse industriële sectoren. 

Omdat onze toegewijde en gedreven engineers de [Hexagon][24] tools van binnen en van buiten kennen,
kunnen wij onze klanten bovendien optimaal ondersteunen met advies en training.

[ Ontdek meer over Simulatie Software ][25]

## En dat sinds 1998, met een enorme passie voor data en techniek

Dat doen wij al sinds 1998 met een enorme passie voor data en techniek en een echte
resultaatgerichte, no-nonsense mentaliteit. In een open, transparante werkomgeving geven wij onze
specialisten graag de ruimte om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. De liefde voor het vak, de vrijheid
en de synergie tussen onze young potentials en vakrotten resulteren in een hecht teamgevoel.

## Werken in een data gedreven organisatie?

Bij In Summa werken wij voor klanten in de [maakindustrie][26], [transportsector][27] en [zorg][28].
En als [Microsoft Solution partner][29] maken wij data toegankelijk en beschikbaar in praktische
business intelligence dashboards. Dit doen wij in een hecht team dat op elkaar bouwt. Elke dag weer
werken we aan de mooiste resultaten. Ben jij enthousiast geworden en wil je bij ons werken?
Solliciteer dan vandaag nog!

## Enterprise Quality Management System (QMS) Software for Regulated Industries

Complete, smart AI QMS platform with integrated LMS for regulated industries — medical device,
pharmaceutical, biotech, manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, food & beverage, and more.

### What is eLeaP QMS?

eLeaP is a comprehensive [quality management system][42] with [enterprise learning management][43]
built into one unified platform. Unlike standalone QMS solutions, eLeaP automatically connects
quality processes to training verification — closing the compliance gap that exists when QMS and
training records live in separate systems.

#### Complete QMS Modules with Training Integration:
* ### Document Control
  
  21 CFR Part 11 compliant document management with version control, approval workflows, and
  automatic training deployment.
* ### Design & Development
  
  Design and development records with full traceability matrix and competency tracking through every
  phase.
* ### Risk Management
  
  ISO 14971, ICH Q9, and FMEA methodologies with risk assessment, mitigation tracking, and residual
  risk monitoring.
* ### Change Control
  
  Complete change lifecycle management with integrated risk assessment and automatic retraining for
  affected personnel.
* ### CAPA Management
  
  Corrective and preventive actions with root cause analysis and effectiveness verification.
* ### Event Management
  
  Complaints, nonconformances, and deviations managed end-to-end with configurable workflows.
* ### Supplier Management
  
  Vendor qualification, audit management, and certificate tracking linked to your internal quality
  processes.
* ### Training Management
  
  21 CFR Part 11 validated training management with competency assessments and skills tracking.
* ### Regulatory Compliance & Standards
  
  Our QMS software supports 21 CFR Part 11 (electronic signatures), QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO
  13485:2016, ISO 9001:2015, AS9100, IATF 16949, ICH guidelines, EU MDR, and cGMP requirements.
  Pre-validated for regulated industries with built-in compliance templates and audit trails.
* ### Proven Results
  
  With 20 years serving regulated industries and 1,544 companies served, eLeaP helps medical device,
  pharmaceutical, biotech, aerospace, automotive, food & beverage, and other regulated organizations
  achieve faster regulatory submissions, maintain continuous audit readiness, and reduce total
  quality management costs — all in one integrated platform.
* ### Industries Served
  
  Medical Devices, Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Aerospace & Defense, Automotive, Food & Beverage,
  Digital Health & SaMD, Clinical Research, Regulated Cannabis & Hemp, Cosmetics & Personal Care,
  Nutraceuticals, Contract Manufacturing (CMO/CDMO), Quality & Regulatory Affairs.
* Document Management

### Document Control with Automatic Training Deployment

Manage SOPs, work instructions, forms, and quality procedures with 21 CFR Part 11 compliant document
control. Full lifecycle management includes version control, approval workflows, and effective
dating. Approved documents automatically become assigned training with completion tracking — so
every document revision triggers required retraining for affected personnel. Monitor who needs
training, who’s completed it, and maintain comprehensive audit trails across all operational states.

[Learn more][44]


### Design & Development with Complete Training Traceability

Manage design and development from concept through commercialization with full traceability across
requirements, specifications, verification, and validation. Build comprehensive design and
development records including design inputs, outputs, reviews, and transfer documentation. Training
requirements cascade automatically through development phases — when specifications change, affected
engineers and technicians are notified and retrained. Generate audit-ready documentation with
integrated competency records for faster regulatory approvals and certification audits.

[Learn more][45]


### Integrated Risk Management with Automated Mitigation Training

eLeaP supports ISO 14971 (MedTech), ICH Q9 (Pharma), and FMEA methodologies in one unified platform.
Conduct comprehensive assessments using customizable probability and severity matrices, generate
risk priority numbers, and track residual risks in real-time. When new control measures are
identified, targeted training is automatically deployed to affected personnel.

Visualize Paths to Harm, maintain living risk registers, and ensure every mitigation strategy
includes verifiable proof of competency for your next audit or inspection.

[Learn more][46]

### Adaptive Event Management with Custom Workflow Templates

Stop forcing your quality processes into rigid software silos. eLeaP’s powerful customizable
templates allow you to build tailored workflows for CAPAs, NCRs, deviations, RCA investigations, and
any other quality event unique to your industry. From initiation to closure, you control the data
fields, approval logic, and containment steps to match your specific SOPs.

[Learn more][47]


### Integrated Operations: Change, Suppliers, Templates & Training.

eLeaP centralizes the lifecycle of your most critical quality operations — Change Control for
document and process modifications, Supplier Management for qualification, audits, and quality
agreements, and Customizable Templates for building industry-specific workflows for any quality
event.
These modules are natively linked to the integrated Training Management engine, ensuring that any
operational shift — whether a document change or a supplier update — automatically triggers targeted
retraining and competency tracking for affected teams, maintaining a continuous state of audit
readiness.

[Learn more][48]

## One Platform for Compliance, Integration, and Audit Readiness.

eLeaP delivers a comprehensive QMS with seven core modules — documents, design & development, risk,
change, quality events, suppliers, and learning — operating as one connected system. Training is
automated across every module, triggering retraining based on document approvals, design changes,
quality events, and audits, so your team stays compliant without manual coordination.
* ### See Your Complete Quality Status
  
  Real-time visibility across documents, design & development, risk, change, events, suppliers, and
  learning. Every quality action is linked to training. One platform. One sign-on. One source of
  truth.
* ### Compliance Without Manual Work
  
  Approved documents trigger training. Design & development, risk, and change updates cascade
  requirements. Events and audits close gaps. Learning tracks completion automatically — no manual
  handoffs.
* ### Connected Data Drives Better Decisions
  
  All seven systems — Documents, Design & Development, Risk, Change, Events, Suppliers, Learning —
  operate as one integrated QMS. Root cause analysis links training and performance data to every
  audit trail.

## Trusted by Regulated Industries for 20+ Years

Medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, aerospace, automotive, food & beverage, and other
regulated industries trust eLeaP to manage compliance at scale. Built on 20 years of proven
infrastructure, our platform embeds compliance into daily workflows — from manufacturing and
clinical research to contract operations (CMO/CDMO) and beyond. Fully 21 CFR Part 11 compliant with
complete audit trails and validated documentation — so every team can focus on quality improvement
while the system ensures no requirement is overlooked.

> process. The thing that was most impressive to me was the customer service.

Nate Barin

## Enterprise Quality Management System (QMS) Software for Regulated Industries

Complete, smart AI QMS platform with integrated LMS for regulated industries — medical device,
pharmaceutical, biotech, manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, food & beverage, and more.

### What is eLeaP QMS?

eLeaP is a comprehensive [quality management system][42] with [enterprise learning management][43]
built into one unified platform. Unlike standalone QMS solutions, eLeaP automatically connects
quality processes to training verification — closing the compliance gap that exists when QMS and
training records live in separate systems.

#### Complete QMS Modules with Training Integration:
* ### Document Control
  
  21 CFR Part 11 compliant document management with version control, approval workflows, and
  automatic training deployment.
* ### Design & Development
  
  Design and development records with full traceability matrix and competency tracking through every
  phase.
* ### Risk Management
  
  ISO 14971, ICH Q9, and FMEA methodologies with risk assessment, mitigation tracking, and residual
  risk monitoring.
* ### Change Control
  
  Complete change lifecycle management with integrated risk assessment and automatic retraining for
  affected personnel.
* ### CAPA Management
  
  Corrective and preventive actions with root cause analysis and effectiveness verification.
* ### Event Management
  
  Complaints, nonconformances, and deviations managed end-to-end with configurable workflows.
* ### Supplier Management
  
  Vendor qualification, audit management, and certificate tracking linked to your internal quality
  processes.
* ### Training Management
  
  21 CFR Part 11 validated training management with competency assessments and skills tracking.
* ### Regulatory Compliance & Standards
  
  Our QMS software supports 21 CFR Part 11 (electronic signatures), QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO
  13485:2016, ISO 9001:2015, AS9100, IATF 16949, ICH guidelines, EU MDR, and cGMP requirements.
  Pre-validated for regulated industries with built-in compliance templates and audit trails.
* ### Proven Results
  
  With 20 years serving regulated industries and 1,544 companies served, eLeaP helps medical device,
  pharmaceutical, biotech, aerospace, automotive, food & beverage, and other regulated organizations
  achieve faster regulatory submissions, maintain continuous audit readiness, and reduce total
  quality management costs — all in one integrated platform.
* ### Industries Served
  
  Medical Devices, Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Aerospace & Defense, Automotive, Food & Beverage,
  Digital Health & SaMD, Clinical Research, Regulated Cannabis & Hemp, Cosmetics & Personal Care,
  Nutraceuticals, Contract Manufacturing (CMO/CDMO), Quality & Regulatory Affairs.

### Document Control with Automatic Training Deployment

Manage SOPs, work instructions, forms, and quality procedures with 21 CFR Part 11 compliant document
control. Full lifecycle management includes version control, approval workflows, and effective
dating. Approved documents automatically become assigned training with completion tracking — so
every document revision triggers required retraining for affected personnel. Monitor who needs
training, who’s completed it, and maintain comprehensive audit trails across all operational states.

[Learn more][44]


### Design & Development with Complete Training Traceability

Manage design and development from concept through commercialization with full traceability across
requirements, specifications, verification, and validation. Build comprehensive design and
development records including design inputs, outputs, reviews, and transfer documentation. Training
requirements cascade automatically through development phases — when specifications change, affected
engineers and technicians are notified and retrained. Generate audit-ready documentation with
integrated competency records for faster regulatory approvals and certification audits.

[Learn more][45]


### Integrated Risk Management with Automated Mitigation Training

eLeaP supports ISO 14971 (MedTech), ICH Q9 (Pharma), and FMEA methodologies in one unified platform.
Conduct comprehensive assessments using customizable probability and severity matrices, generate
risk priority numbers, and track residual risks in real-time. When new control measures are
identified, targeted training is automatically deployed to affected personnel.

Visualize Paths to Harm, maintain living risk registers, and ensure every mitigation strategy
includes verifiable proof of competency for your next audit or inspection.

[Learn more][46]

### Adaptive Event Management with Custom Workflow Templates

Stop forcing your quality processes into rigid software silos. eLeaP’s powerful customizable
templates allow you to build tailored workflows for CAPAs, NCRs, deviations, RCA investigations, and
any other quality event unique to your industry. From initiation to closure, you control the data
fields, approval logic, and containment steps to match your specific SOPs.

[Learn more][47]


### Integrated Operations: Change, Suppliers, Templates & Training.

eLeaP centralizes the lifecycle of your most critical quality operations — Change Control for
document and process modifications, Supplier Management for qualification, audits, and quality
agreements, and Customizable Templates for building industry-specific workflows for any quality
event.
These modules are natively linked to the integrated Training Management engine, ensuring that any
operational shift — whether a document change or a supplier update — automatically triggers targeted
retraining and competency tracking for affected teams, maintaining a continuous state of audit
readiness.

[Learn more][48]

## One Platform for Compliance, Integration, and Audit Readiness.

eLeaP delivers a comprehensive QMS with seven core modules — documents, design & development, risk,
change, quality events, suppliers, and learning — operating as one connected system. Training is
automated across every module, triggering retraining based on document approvals, design changes,
quality events, and audits, so your team stays compliant without manual coordination.
* ### See Your Complete Quality Status
  
  Real-time visibility across documents, design & development, risk, change, events, suppliers, and
  learning. Every quality action is linked to training. One platform. One sign-on. One source of
  truth.
* ### Compliance Without Manual Work
  
  Approved documents trigger training. Design & development, risk, and change updates cascade
  requirements. Events and audits close gaps. Learning tracks completion automatically — no manual
  handoffs.
* ### Connected Data Drives Better Decisions
  
  All seven systems — Documents, Design & Development, Risk, Change, Events, Suppliers, Learning —
  operate as one integrated QMS. Root cause analysis links training and performance data to every
  audit trail.

## Trusted by Regulated Industries for 20+ Years

Medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, aerospace, automotive, food & beverage, and other
regulated industries trust eLeaP to manage compliance at scale. Built on 20 years of proven
infrastructure, our platform embeds compliance into daily workflows — from manufacturing and
clinical research to contract operations (CMO/CDMO) and beyond. Fully 21 CFR Part 11 compliant with
complete audit trails and validated documentation — so every team can focus on quality improvement
while the system ensures no requirement is overlooked.

engineering problems.

# Siemens Channel Partner for Advanced Engineering Simulation

TrueInsight helps engineering teams leverage Altair and Siemens simulation platforms for structural
analysis, CFD, electromagnetics, manufacturing, and AI-driven optimization.

[Find the right solution for you][197]

## Engineering & Digital Engineering Capabilities

From concept design to lifecycle management, TrueInsight helps engineering teams design, validate,
manufacture, and manage complex products using Siemens and Altair technologies.

[ Get Started ][198]
[
[motionsolve_product_diagram.webp]

### Product Design

Create and refine product concepts, assemblies, and engineering geometry using professional CAD and
industrial design tools. From early concepts to detailed mechanical models, teams develop accurate
digital representations before analysis or manufacturing begins.

Explore Product Design →
][199][
[altair_simulation.webp]

### Engineering Simulation

Evaluate performance before building prototypes. Structural, thermal, and multiphysics simulation
helps predict failures, vibration, cooling behavior, and system response so engineering decisions
are validated early.

Explore Engineering Simulation →
][200][
[EN21.webp]

### Manufacturing Engineering

Verify manufacturability and production processes before tooling. Manufacturing simulation and CAM
programming allow teams to predict defects, optimize tooling, and generate CNC machining strategies
directly from engineering models.

Explore Manufacturing →
][201][
[corp_customerstory_motorola_resourcelibrary_thumbnail_1200x628-jpg.webp]

### Electronics & Systems

Develop and validate electronic and control behavior for modern products. Power electronics,
embedded systems, and control logic can be modeled and tested virtually before hardware
implementation.

Explore Electronics & Systems →
][202][
[DataScience_600x600.webp]

### Data & Optimization

Use operational and engineering data to improve performance and reliability. Analytics and machine
learning tools help predict failures, monitor systems, and optimize industrial processes.

Explore Data & Optimization →
][203][
[altair_cfd_1200x628-png.webp]

### Product Lifecycle Management

Manage product data, revisions, and collaboration across departments. PLM platforms connect design,
simulation, manufacturing, and operations into a single controlled workflow.

Explore PLM →
][204]

Industry-proven CAE tools for structural, fluid, thermal, and electromagnetic analysis.

Industry-leading pre-processing and meshing software for finite element analysis (FEA). Used by
automotive and aerospace engineering teams to prepare high-quality simulation models efficiently.

View HyperMesh →

[siemens-nx.webp]

### Siemens NX CAD/CAE

Advanced CAD, simulation, and manufacturing environment for complex product development. NX enables
integrated design, analysis, and digital twin workflows in a single engineering platform.

Explore NX →

### Siemens Solid Edge

Professional 3D CAD software combining parametric and synchronous modeling. Ideal for mechanical
design, assemblies, drafting, and manufacturing preparation.

Learn Solid Edge →

CAD-embedded computational fluid dynamics (CFD) software that allows engineers to analyze airflow,
cooling, and thermal performance directly inside the design environment.

Power electronics and motor drive simulation software for inverters, converters, and control
systems. Widely used in EV, renewable energy, and embedded systems development.

Explore PSIM →

Advanced CFD and multiphysics simulation platform for aerodynamics, thermal management, battery

Explore STAR-CCM+ →
][211]

## Integrating Simulation Into Real Engineering Workflows

[shopfloor-software---virtual-safety.webp]

### Integrating Simulation

Engineering Implementation Framework

The implementation begins with an assessment of the company’s product development workflow, CAD
environment, and manufacturing constraints to determine where simulation can generate the greatest
impact. A pilot project is then carried out using a real component to demonstrate value, typically
analyzing structural, thermal, or flow behavior.

Once validated, simulation is integrated into the existing design process so engineers can verify
performance during development instead of after prototyping. The team is onboarded using real models
and practical use cases, and ongoing technical guidance ensures simulation becomes a routine
engineering activity rather than an isolated analysis task.

## Engineering Expertise You Can Rely On

[community.webp]

### Practical support for real-world engineering simulation adoption.

TrueInsight is a team of engineers, analysts, and simulation specialists who believe the best
technology is only as powerful as the people using it. That’s why we don’t just sell world-class
tools from Altair and Siemens, we teach you how to use them to their full potential. Whether you
need help selecting the right FEA method, automating repetitive tasks, or training your team on best
practices, we’ve got your back

We’ve helped everyone from aerospace innovators to EV startups streamline simulation and scale
smarter. At TrueInsight, you’re not just buying software, you’re gaining a partner who’s been in the
simulation trenches.

TrueInsight helps engineering teams leverage Altair and Siemens simulation platforms for structural
analysis, CFD, electromagnetics, manufacturing, and AI-driven optimization.

## Engineering & Digital Engineering Capabilities

From concept design to lifecycle management, TrueInsight helps engineering teams design, validate,
manufacture, and manage complex products using Siemens and Altair technologies.

are validated early.

## Integrating Simulation Into Real Engineering Workflows

[shopfloor-software---virtual-safety.webp]

### Integrating Simulation

Engineering Implementation Framework

The implementation begins with an assessment of the company’s product development workflow, CAD
environment, and manufacturing constraints to determine where simulation can generate the greatest
impact. A pilot project is then carried out using a real component to demonstrate value, typically
analyzing structural, thermal, or flow behavior.

Once validated, simulation is integrated into the existing design process so engineers can verify
performance during development instead of after prototyping. The team is onboarded using real models
and practical use cases, and ongoing technical guidance ensures simulation becomes a routine
engineering activity rather than an isolated analysis task.

## Engineering Expertise You Can Rely On

[community.webp]

### Practical support for real-world engineering simulation adoption.

TrueInsight is a team of engineers, analysts, and simulation specialists who believe the best
technology is only as powerful as the people using it. That’s why we don’t just sell world-class
tools from Altair and Siemens, we teach you how to use them to their full potential. Whether you
need help selecting the right FEA method, automating repetitive tasks, or training your team on best
practices, we’ve got your back

We’ve helped everyone from aerospace innovators to EV startups streamline simulation and scale
smarter. At TrueInsight, you’re not just buying software, you’re gaining a partner who’s been in the
simulation trenches.
